decisions.reason: The compact rotating dumper extends the firm's core construction range and still has its own page, so keeping this option open costs little while its market value is still emerging.
The articulated dumper builds directly on established competencies and is still actively presented, so it shares existing production and service and is cheap to keep.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core and has slipped from its own page to a mere mention, which signals weaker prospects, but niche safety vehicles have long sales cycles and the option is still cheap to keep for now.
The telescopic loader line has several models close to the core business and is still actively presented, so it is a valuable growth option worth continued investment.
The material lift line is confirmed by a large order and strong popularity in the rental market, so its value is largely shown and it justifies further commitment.
The compact mining loader already shows strong field results, with 1,000 operating hours in 7 months, which resolves uncertainty favorably and supports keeping and expanding it.
